name: io.github.reeinharddd/snapmcp
title: snapmcp
description: Visual documentation: terminal, code, browser, Markdown, HTML, diffs, PDF, GIF, and Office files.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory that confines every generated artifact (default: ./captures)

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_THEME
environmentVariables.description: One of 27 built-in Shiki themes; terminal palettes are detected heuristically

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Output image format: png or jpeg

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Comma- or semicolon-separated file-read allowlist; file reads are denied when unset

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_SSRF_PROTECTION
environmentVariables.description: Block private and local URL targets, including DNS-resolved private addresses

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_SECURITY_CHECKS
environmentVariables.description: Enable broader input and file-read validation; output confinement and URL protocol checks remain active

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_CHROME_EXECUTABLE
environmentVariables.description: Explicit system Chrome or Chromium executable; Playwright Chromium is the default

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_CHROME_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: Playwright Chrome channel, such as stable, beta, dev, or canary

environmentVariables.name: SNAPMCP_CHROME_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Experimental persistent Chromium user-data directory: detected profile key/name or absolute path

list.name: capture_terminal
list.description: Render terminal lines as a PNG or JPEG, with heuristic terminal palette detection and $ or # prompt markers.

list.name: capture_code
list.description: Render source code with Shiki highlighting for 300+ bundled languages and 27 themes, with an optional inclusive line range.

list.name: capture_browser
list.description: Capture a full-page or viewport screenshot of an HTTP(S) URL with default-on SSRF protection.

list.name: capture_file
list.description: Render an allowlisted file with extension-based language mapping and an optional inclusive line range; file reads are deny-all by default.

list.name: capture_markdown
list.description: Render GitHub-flavored Markdown as a PNG or JPEG; raw HTML is escaped and external resources are blocked.

list.name: capture_html
list.description: Render sanitized HTML and CSS in a JavaScript-disabled, network-isolated context; active and external content is removed or blocked.

list.name: capture_diff
list.description: Render a unified diff as a PNG or JPEG with additions and deletions highlighted.

list.name: capture_pdf
list.description: Print a complete HTTP(S) URL document to a PDF with Chromium.

list.name: capture_batch
list.description: Capture up to 10 independent typed items in one call and return their saved image paths.

list.name: capture_sequence
list.description: Capture up to 60 ordered steps as individual images and optionally compile a GIF.

list.name: capture_gif
list.description: Create a GIF from 2 to 60 PNG captures; loop true repeats forever and loop false plays once.

list.name: capture_document
list.description: Embed up to 30 captioned captures in a Markdown, self-contained HTML, print-quality PDF, editable PowerPoint, or editable Word document.

list.name: snapmcp-hint
list.description: Find the right tool by natural-language intent or return concise setup, security, and token guidance.
